key_highlights: Energy crisis escalates: Saudi pipeline outage + Houthi shipping threats push diesel to record $6/gallon, oil back to $100, stoking food and transport inflation
Bond market stress: 10-year Treasury yield hits 4.94% despite $5.2B Bessent buyback; mortgage rates surging for 3rd straight day; inflation outpacing wage growth
AI capex supercycle intensifies: Anthropic locks $517B compute, Oracle chips at 97.9% utilization, Goldman sees 6.5M humanoid robots by 2035, but ROI questions mount
Geopolitical risk premium elevated: Ukraine drone strikes on passenger trains, Iran seeks Gulf support for Hormuz plan, Trump urges Zelenskyy to stop hitting Russian refineries
Fed policy divergence: Trump pressures for cuts while market bets on Warsh hike; CPI ticked up in August, complicating rate path
Equities resilient despite dot-com vibes: Wall Street advises staying in stocks; EM unfazed by Fed risk; but traders split on plunge vs. drift protection
Labor market mixed: Pay rising for job switchers even in low-hire environment, but inflation squeezing real purchasing power

Favor AI infrastructure with revenue (ORCL, NVDA) over pure-play compute; watch Alibaba $10.2B test and Anthropic IPO timing
Overweight dividend growers and TIPS; underweight consumer discretionary; monitor CPI vs. wage data monthly

Favor companies with internal governance (Anthropic model); avoid unregulated AI plays; monitor congressional action

market_outlook.short_term: Volatile and choppy. Energy shock + bond market stress + CPI data create two-way risk. Equities resilient but traders hedging. Diesel at $6 and oil at $100 keep inflation sticky. Fed caught between Trump pressure and hawkish data. Expect 5-8% equity volatility over next 6-8 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI capex cycle and defense spending provide structural growth, but ROI questions and energy costs cap multiples. EM and BRICS diversification offers alpha. Inflation likely moderates by Q1 2027 if energy stabilizes, enabling 1-2 Fed cuts. 6-12 month equity target: modest 5-8% gains with sector rotation favoring energy, defense, and AI infrastructure.
